true_side_reply.rebuttal: The wording establishes a promoted deposit bonus, not a deceptive one: it does not promise that every viewer receives 50K USDT or establish that the bonus is easy to obtain. Without evidence of false terms or a misleading claim, an incompletely detailed promotion is not enough to characterize the video as a scam.
